headline: Apple teases MacBook Pro event next week
summary: Apple announced a product launch event for October 28th. New MacBook Pros and an updated iPad Mini are expected. The big announcement is likely a new MacBook Pro with an OLED screen.

headline: Amazon is funding a new nuclear plant in Indiana
summary: Amazon partnered with X-energy and AEP to fund a new nuclear plant in Indiana. The facility aims to provide up to 960 megawatts of carbon-free energy. It will replace a former coal-fueled power station.

headline: Apple’s last-gen Mac Mini with the M4 is $150 off
summary: Best Buy offers $150 off the M4 Mac Mini base model. This deal is for the 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD configuration. It's a significant saving on the last-gen model.

headline: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
summary: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker discusses AI's potential benefits and risks. He believes AI could significantly extend human lifespan. Pritzker also warns AI could pose a nuclear-level threat.

headline: Abbott & Costello Join Forces With Kolchak the Night Stalker in Horror Crossover Special
summary: Comedy icons Abbott & Costello return to comics after 50 years. They are joining forces with Kolchak the Night Stalker. This marks a new horror crossover special.

headline: PlayStation Shadowdrops Saros Zenith Update With Boss Rush, New Game+ and Fancy Golden Crown Powerups
summary: A new Zenith update for Saros dropped today. It introduces a challenging Boss Rush mode. Players can now enjoy New Game+ and discover Fancy Golden Crown Powerups.

headline: Don't Miss Out on Amazon's Fall Audible Deal: Pay $0.99 Per Month Plus Get $20 Credit
summary: Amazon is offering a special fall deal for Audible. New and most previous subscribers pay $0.99 per month. The deal also includes a generous $20 credit.

headline: PlayStation 6 RAM and Storage Alone May Cost $680, According to Leaker
summary: A new rumor suggests high costs for PlayStation 6 components. The RAM and storage alone could cost $680. This is reportedly more than the entire cost of a PS5.

headline: Watch: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
summary: France experienced widespread rioting, looting, and vandalism. Protests escalated across the country over the weekend. The events raise questions about upcoming elections.

headline: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
summary: An Australian independent MP was critically injured. They were hit by a car in an apparent deliberate attack. The prime minister confirmed the incident.

headline: Woman says she 'closed eyes and tried not to be there' during alleged Russell Brand rape
summary: A woman testified about an alleged rape by Russell Brand. She described closing her eyes and trying to dissociate. Brand faces multiple charges, including three counts of rape.

headline: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
summary: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murders. He instructed parents to starve their children. All but one victim were children.
